Our assessment: not relevant to util-linux 2.38.1-5+deb12u3. The inspected upstream 2.38.1 mount implementation and Debian patch set do not contain the newer privileged post-mount hooks involved in this CVE. Red Hat identifies affected versions as 2.39 through 2.42.2. Debian still labels Bookworm vulnerable and Scout matches this package; this is an explicitly documented disagreement, not a claim that Debian has issued a fix. The inspected KV image also has no user-mountable fstab entries or external mount helpers, but this exclusion is based on the reviewed package implementation. Removing setuid bits was suggested as additional hardening and has not been applied. Sources: https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-76642 ; https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-m25x-3hj9-m26f ; https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-76642 ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/util-linux/util-linux/v2.38.1/libmount/src/context_mount.c ; https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/u/util-linux/util-linux_2.38.1-5+deb12u3.debian.tar.xz (reviewed 2026-09-08). The libblkid-only 2.38.1-5+deb12u3+openriak1 backport changes partition allocation only and does not introduce the later util-linux implementation implicated in this CVE.

Our assessment: not relevant to Debian zlib 1:1.2.13.dfsg-1. The CNA's CVE record identifies affected versions 1.3.1.2 through 1.3.2 and marks other versions unaffected. The vulnerable gz_vacate() function is absent from the inspected Debian 1.2.13 upstream source and Debian patch archive; their hashes match the retained source evidence. Debian's tracker still labels Bookworm vulnerable, so this records our source-based applicability assessment and the tracker disagreement, not a claim that a patch was installed or that upstream has endorsed our assessment. No zlib upgrade is needed for this specific issue in the reviewed package. Sources: https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2026/85xxx/CVE-2026-85091.json ; https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-85091 ; https://github.com/madler/zlib/issues/1310 . Our assessment: not relevant to util-linux 2.38.1-5+deb12u3. CVE-2026-78410 concerns restricted bind-mount source redirection followed by privileged X-mount.owner/group/mode operations. Red Hat states these options were introduced in 2.39 and earlier releases are not affected; fixed releases for affected versions are 2.41.6 and 2.42.3. The inspected 2.38.1 mount implementation lacks the newer hook_owner/open_tree path described in the upstream advisory, and the inspected Debian patches do not introduce these ownership/mode hooks. Debian's tracker nevertheless flags Bookworm; this is our version-specific applicability assessment, not an installed backport or a blanket claim about other mount vulnerabilities. Sources: https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-78410 ; https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-rh77-686x-2f2m ; https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-78410 ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/util-linux/util-linux/v2.38.1/libmount/src/context_mount.c ; https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/u/util-linux/util-linux_2.38.1-5+deb12u3.debian.tar.xz (reviewed 2026-09-08).
